reason: parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:25-27 sets data.refresh_token to the literal "refresh_token" whenever the response has none. That happens in both modes: in sync mode the minimum schema drops unknown keys, so the token is always missing. office365calendar CalendarService.ts:56 makes refresh_token optional and line 264 spreads the parsed data over the stored credentials, so the real token is overwritten with the literal. Zoom VideoApiAdapter.ts:120 stores newTokens.refresh_token the same way. Before the patch, Zod v3 left a missing optional key out of its output, so the spread kept the stored token.
